Department of Background Music

Sim Score

Pieces of music written as code, in the spirit of SimCity, Spore, The Sims and their neighbours, and a houseband that plays whatever fits what is happening. Nothing is recorded. Every note is composed in your browser a few bars before it plays, so each performance is new and none of them ends.

How it works

Each piece is a function that composes a few bars at a time, just before they play. A small theory engine parses chord symbols, picks voicings that lead smoothly from the last chord, and writes melodic lines that land chord tones on strong beats. Each piece carries its own memory of form, motifs and loop phases, so the music develops over minutes instead of looping.

Every instrument is synthesized live with Tone.js: FM for electric pianos, bells and basses, Karplus–Strong for guitars and koto, filtered noise and tuned membranes for a drum room that runs from brushes and congas to 808s, gated snares, surdos and taiko. There are no samples.

The houseband reads two things about every piece: the situations it suits and its energy. Pick a situation and it chooses a tune that fits, avoiding what it just played; pull the energy down and the drummer lays out, then the bass player, the way a real band would bring it down for a quiet moment.
